method: Node VM with mocked DOM/localStorage/host; no browser, mobile or print verification

checks.name: All 90 practice questions use four distinct diagnostic display words, including the answer
Every word has nine different distractor sets covering all other diagnosis words
Assessment and period-review questions remain identical to the prior release
All mixed questions render lesson choices and still score correctly after shuffling and restart
A prior unanswered question replaces foreign choices and clears only its unsubmitted selection
All queued prior-release questions update, and fresh choice ordering remains stable on a second reload
Host-state restoration applies the same lesson-choice migration
Submitted first answers and their original question snapshot are preserved
Retrying an old answered question uses diagnosis choices while retaining its first-answer evidence
Pending retry choice and its new snapshot survive restart without rewriting the original answer
A retry already in progress in the prior release updates its choices without losing first or submitted retries
Confirmed teacher grades and all ten writing submissions survive the content update unchanged
Invalid foreign options in the current content bank cannot enter a new plan
